verdicts.reason: A keeps text, button and legal line on one clean left edge with the can and circle beside them, but it is a centred cluster rather than a real banner layout: about 225px of empty space on the left, the stack fills the full height, and the circle no longer bleeds off the edge as it does in the original. B keeps the bleeding circle but its left edges don't line up (eyebrow and headline at ~138, body copy at ~134, button at ~124), the legal line is pushed out of the column to x≈228, and a large dead gap separates the copy from the can on the far right, so the layout looks broken up.
